minutes.headline: Committee rated and approved job descriptions for several town positions in the salary plan review; next meeting set for Oct 17.
minutes.summary: The committee heard a sewer business manager dispute her position's rating, approved the Sept 6 minutes, and tabled vacation leave accrual until all four members can attend. It then reviewed, amended and approved job descriptions and scored positions on the rubric: sewer assistant, public safety head clerk, reserve police officer, and executive assistant to the town manager. It discussed next steps for outlier positions and chose Oct 17 at 5:30 for the next meeting.

public_comment.topic: Objected to the committee's grade 10 rating of her position (she and her supervisor scored it a 7), called the job description outdated, and asked that employees and supervisors be able to review ratings and discuss disagreements.
Closing public comment invited; no one spoke.

what_happened.line: The committee approved the executive assistant to the town manager and select board job description as amended, after rating the position.
It accepted the public safety head clerk job description as amended, and amended the reserve officer description to add accountability language.
The vote to approve the reserve police officer job description with a title amendment is not audible in the recording.
A sewer business manager objected to the grade given her position; the committee then rated the assistant to that position.
Vacation leave accrual was tabled until all four members can attend, and the next meeting was set for the 17th at 5:30 pm.

why_it_matters: Job descriptions and grade ratings feed the town's classification and salary study, which sets the pay grid for town employees and has to be done in time for the finance committee and the town meeting warrant.
Vacation leave accrual, which affects every town employee's benefits, has not been decided and waits for a full committee.
watch_next: Next Personnel Committee meeting on the 17th at 5:30 pm, with vacation leave accrual on the agenda and the outlier spreadsheet from HR for review.
The salary study timeline set against the finance committee and the town meeting warrant.
